functions.note: chunks overlapping the tile, per chunk mark walkable + rasterise (flagMergeThr = climb)

functions.note: compact (min of three heights), Valve erode, median filter if *(1801386a8)+0x58, regions by *(1801386b8)+0x58: 0 watershed, 1 monotone, else layers

functions.name: CNavGenRecastTile::Collect
functions.note: detail vertices back through the inverse matrix into the pool; each detail triangle a 3-vertex CNavGenPoly (18004fe30); area 0x20 flag 4 else 1; area 0x3d kind 1, 0x3e kind 2
